intended_object: An auxiliary isomorphism. It identifies the limit of the power-quotient diagram G/G^n of a procyclic profinite group with the limit of the residue diagram ℤ/nℤ, over n supported on a set of primes S. It is induced by the natural isomorphism of diagrams that comes from a chosen topological generator, assuming the exact-index condition [G : G^n] = n. This is inferred from the docstring and from its use in `continuousMulEquivSupportedResidueLimit`.
explanation:
This is not a mathematical object in its own right. It is a transport isomorphism, an intermediate step in proving that a torsion-free procyclic group G is isomorphic to lim_n ℤ/nℤ, with n ranging over integers supported on the primes of infinite exponent (Neukirch–Schmidt–Wingberg, Ch. I §7).

The body only applies `IsLimit.conePointsIsoOfNatIso` to the library's natural isomorphism `residuePowerQuotientNatIso` (inverted with `.symm`) between the residue diagram and the power-quotient diagram. This is the standard way to get the induced isomorphism of limits, so the construction is sound.

Its role is internal bookkeeping. Its only use is inside `continuousMulEquivSupportedResidueLimit`, which carries the actual mathematical content. No standard notion in the literature corresponds to this isomorphism, so there is nothing to compare it against for faithfulness or generality.
